audit.why: Kennen contesting levels 1 and 4-6 with Akali taking 2-3 and the item windows matches 47.26% Emerald+ over 530 games and the disk chart. Chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed 'Lightning Rush online' as Kennen's spike.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is a mobility/Mark-applier on 10s at rank 1; it is not a power spike. His actual spikes are the third Mark of the Storm stun and Slicing Maelstrom at 6.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes rewritten around three-Mark stun and level-6 Slicing Maelstrom.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'track this ability' line pointed at Lightning Rush; Mark of the Storm and Electrical Surge appeared nowhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm stuns at three stacks, and Q/W/E/R all apply one - that is the interaction that decides the lane. Electrical Surge is on-hit and attack-speed scaled, which is why MR and not armour is the answer.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, breakdown.early, phases[1]/[3]/[5].why, dosFull and dontsFull[1].d rebuilt around Marks, Thundering Shuriken's 7s and Slicing Maelstrom's 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage on Lightning Rush's cooldown' was the headline advice.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s - never meaningfully down. The punishable cooldown is Slicing Maelstrom at a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0] and phases[5].why now key on the 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'Build MR' do-entry carried generic trade text, not itemisation.
audit.why: Kennen's Electrical Surge applies on-hit magic damage and scales with attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now says MR over armour and names Mercury's Treads.

edits.before: Build MR — shroud his combo, Q-poke him. Akali wins the Lightning Rush cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build MR — shroud his combo, Q-poke him. Akali wins the Slicing Maelstrom windows.

edits.before: Build MR and poke him down. Track Lightning Rush before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR and poke him down. Track Slicing Maelstrom's 120s before every commit and hold the wave.

edits.before: Kennen wins by landing Lightning Rush, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Kennen wins by stacking three Marks of the Storm into a stun, then bursting you inside his R.

edits.before: Q Kennen at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Trade after Thundering Shuriken whiffs — 7s at rank 1 — E-dash the angle and shroud the return fire.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Respect Kennen's Lightning Rush completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Q-poke loses here: Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 to your Q's 550 and stamps a Mark on you. Sidestep it and his stun stack never builds — bank CS, not pride.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Lightning Rush: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Slicing Maelstrom: once the 120s is burning, run your full pattern; while it is up, give nothing and never eat a third Mark.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Slicing Maelstrom: matchup-defining — 120s flat, its pulses stack Marks to stun you. Bait it, then all-in. - Thundering Shuriken: 7s at rank 1 — sidestep it and his stun never builds. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Q Kennen at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Good trade: step up after Thundering Shuriken whiffs — 7s at rank 1 — E-dash the angle and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kennen spends Slicing Maelstrom, so nothing can stun you — commit the full pattern. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.

edits.after: Kennen: the third Mark of the Storm stun, level-6 Slicing Maelstrom, first item. Akali: levels 2-3, Lich Bane first-item spike, the 2-item window.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Step up only after Thundering Shuriken's 7s whiff.

edits.after: The lane-control window: trade on a whiffed Thundering Shuriken and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Lightning Rush's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Slicing Maelstrom's 120s.

edits.after: Track Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom before you commit

notes: Lightning Rush (10/9/8/7/6s) was the tracked ability across this whole file and is not a window worth waiting for; Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s is. Content layer was already accurate and specific and was left alone. The claim in content.late/spikes[3] that Slicing Maelstrom's pulses still tick on Akali inside Twilight Shroud is consistent with Riot's wording (Shroud prevents being selected by spells and attacks, not persistent zones) but is not stated in the kit file - listed as unverified.
